name: Explicit Finance Limited
about: Explicit Finance Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company provides individual/corporate finance; loans against shares and securities, and property; and financial consultancy services. It is also involved in the trading of securities and investment activities. The company was formerly known as Shubhyog Finlease Limited. Explicit Finance Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Thane, India.
